summary: A 20 by 20 ft tent fits about 33 guests at round tables, 50 in ceremony rows or 57 standing. Frame tents have an open inside and go on any surface; pole tents need center poles and stakes. Common sizes run from 10 by 10 to 40 by 100 ft.
